name: Banco BMG S.A.
summary: Banco BMG S.A. provides commercial and credit, financing, and investment products and services primarily in Brazil. The company offers digital accounts; digital account credit card and consigned credit card; payroll and personal loan; insurance products, including lender, life, family life, and FGTS Protected insurance, as well as Bmg Med and Bmg Consortium services. It also provides investment products, such as bank deposit certificates, agribusiness letter of credit, and letters of real estate credit.
